error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: The page stopped working. Reloading usually fixes it; nothing you sent was lost.

login.title: Sign in
login.helper: Use the account provided by your administrator.

error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.helper: Enter the code from your authenticator app

recovery.helper: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Capitals and the dash do not matter.

error.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Check the app and try again.
error.recoveryIncomplete: Enter one of your recovery codes.
error.invalidRecoveryCode: That recovery code is not valid. Each code works once — check whether you have already used it.
error.challengeLost: That verification step expired. Sign in again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.

resetRequest.title: Reset your password
resetRequest.helper: Enter the email address associated with your account.
resetRequest.confirmation: If that address exists, a reset link is on its way.
resetRequest.confirmationHelper: The link is valid for {{minutes, number}} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.

error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.helper: Choose a password you have not used on this instance before.
resetPassword.done: Your password was reset. Sign in with the new one.

error.tooShort: The new password must be at least {{minimum, number}} characters.
error.invalidToken: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.
error.unexpected: The password could not be reset. Try again.

changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.forcedNotice: Your temporary password must be replaced before you continue.

error.tooShort: The new password must be at least {{minimum, number}} characters.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.
error.unexpected: The password could not be changed. Try again.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your password change has been started but not saved.

security.lede: Your password, two-step verification, and the devices signed in to your account.
security.otherSessionsNote: Changing your password does not sign out your other sessions. Sign them out below if you need to.

totp.explainer: An authenticator app generates a six-digit code that Hamlaneh asks for after your password. Codes are produced on your device, so they work without a network.

disablePrompt.title: Turn off two-step verification?
disablePrompt.body: Your account goes back to password-only. Your recovery codes stop working.

regeneratePrompt.title: Generate new recovery codes?
regeneratePrompt.body: Every code in your current set stops working the moment the new ones appear.

scan.title: Scan this with your authenticator app
scan.lede: Any TOTP app works — Aegis, Ente Auth, 1Password, Bitwarden. Nothing is sent to us during setup.
scan.qrNote: The code is rendered from the key below it. It is never a stored image.
scan.step1: Open your authenticator app and add a new account.
scan.step2: Scan the code, or enter the key by hand if the camera is not an option.
scan.step3: Enter the six-digit code it shows on the next step.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.lede: Each code signs you in once if you lose the authenticator. Treat them like your password.
codes.warning: Store these in a password manager or somewhere physically safe — not in this chat. This is the only time they are shown. Without them and without your authenticator, only an administrator can restore access.
codes.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes and copy them by hand.
codes.regenerateNote: You can generate a fresh set later from Security. Doing so invalidates every code above.
codes.acknowledge: I have saved these codes somewhere safe

error.invalidCode: That code did not match. Check your app's clock is correct.
error.alreadyEnabled: Two-step verification is already on for this account.
error.notEnabled: Two-step verification is not on for this account.
error.setupExpired: That setup expired. Start again from the first step.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.networkError: We could not reach the server. Try again.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.lede: Every device currently signed in to your account. Signing one out ends it immediately.
sessions.locationNote: Locations are estimated from the IP address and are often approximate. If a session looks wrong, sign it out and change your password.

confirmOthers.body: This device stays signed in. The others must sign in again, including the desktop app.

error.loadFailed: We could not load your sessions. Try again.
error.revokeFailed: That session could not be signed out. Try again.

language.lede: Applies immediately and flips the whole interface direction. Nothing you have typed is lost.
language.note: No flags — a language is not a country. The organization's default sets what new accounts get; this overrides it for you only.

appearance.lede: Applies immediately. System follows your operating system, including when it changes at dusk.
appearance.note: Each option is a real preview built from the theme's own tokens, not a coloured square.

chat.noConversations: You are not in any conversation yet. Create a channel to start one.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this message?
deleteConfirm.body: It is removed for everyone in {{channel}}. A placeholder stays in its place.

composer.attachUnavailable: File sharing is not available yet.
composer.hintSend: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
composer.disconnected: Disconnected. Your message is kept and sends itself when the connection returns.
composer.attachUnavailableLabel: Attach a file — file sharing is not available yet
composer.closed: The connection was closed. Reload the page to send again.

search.label: Search results
search.filesPending: File search arrives with file sharing.

empty.title: This is the beginning of {{channel}}
empty.body: Give it a topic so people know what belongs here, then invite the few who need it.
empty.bodyOwner: You created this channel today. Give it a topic so people know what belongs here, then invite the few who need it.
empty.onlyYou: Only you can see this channel until someone is invited.

createChannel.title: Create a channel
createChannel.visibilityNote: Both kinds are visible only to their members. Nobody can find or read a channel they were not invited to.
createChannel.failed: The channel could not be created.

channelMenu.dmNote: A direct message has no topic and its membership is fixed.

people.failed: That did not work. Try again.
